headline: Man United need big January transfer spend to avoid Premier League relegation
description: Manchester United have a choice: spend £150 million on new players in January, or lose £300 million if they get relegated at the end of the Premier League season.

headline: Man United in a relegation battle? Jamie Carragher explains 'problem' they face
description: Manchester United could become embroiled in a relegation battle from the Premier League due to the strength of traditionally smaller clubs, Jamie Carragher said.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: AC Milan to land Liverpool defender Virgil van Dijk?
description: AC Milan are monitoring the situation of Liverpool defender Virgil van Dijk. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Rough start for Pochettino at Manchester United
description: Liverpool put four past Manchester United at home as the Red Devils sink to 19th on the table and immediately put Mauricio Pochettino under pressure.

headline: Bruno Fernandes disputes Leny Yoro red card in Liverpool's rout of Man United
description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes was not happy with the officiating in Sunday's 4-0 drubbing at Liverpool.

headline: Pochettino: Isak wasn't in control of the ball for Yoro red card
description: Mauricio Pochettino reacts to Leny Yoro's red card in Manchester United's 4-0 loss to Liverpool.
